statement: For every degree and p=2,3, H1(S3,T_n,p)=0 for the actual integral special outer tripod lattice. Hence every invariant integral special leading term lifts to an S3-centralizing continuous special outer IA automorphism of the free pro-p tripod group. In particular q7,2q7,3q7 have infinite lifts at both exceptional primes, and their first nonzero pentagon defect persists. Together with B.12 the assertion holds for every prime.
where_proved: sections/g_uniform_lifting.tex; primary inputs Bryant-Kovacs-Stohr2002 Theorem2 and Kovacs-Stohr2000 Theorem7.1/Corollary4.4, with complete norm, cohomology, correction and convergence arguments in the manuscript
manuscript_passages: Explicit prompt follow-up: uniform exceptional-prime integral lifting; closes the prime-by-prime obligation recorded in B.14
notes: The equivariant kernel lattice and the generator conventions are explicit. At2, the swapped-pair/sign basis gives norm-surjectivity in every free Lie degree. At3, the integral L1,L3,L4,L5 decomposition gives augmentation/regular C3 lattices in every degree except2; the zero special degree2 is handled separately. Exact cohomology sequences prove uniform H1 vanishing. Successive group cocycle corrections converge in the actual pro-p topology. This is independent of finite-jet extrapolation and does not assert a full profinite assembly.
